# Sirchie

> > Sirchie is a 75+ year leader in forensic equipment, supplies, and training for law enforcement agencies, offering comprehensive solutions for crime scene investigation, evidence collection, and fingerprint development.

Sirchie provides an extensive catalog of forensic products and services designed for professional crime scene investigators, forensic technicians, and law enforcement agencies. The site features detailed product information, support resources, and advanced search capabilities to help customers find specialized equipment for evidence discovery, processing, and preservation.

## Key Topics

- Latent Fingerprint Development
- RUVIS Imaging Systems
- Cyanoacrylate Fuming
- Forensic Evidence Collection
- Crime Scene Investigation
- Fingerprint Powders
- DNA-Free Processing
- Chemical Development
- Forensic Supplies
- Evidence Recovery
- UV Imaging Technology
- Law Enforcement Training
- Forensic Equipment
- Ninhydrin Processing
- Crime Lab Solutions

## Core Products & Catalog

- [Forensic Products, Equipment and Supplies from Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics.html): Forensic products catalog: crime scene evidence discovery, collection, processing, preservation.

## Latent Fingerprint Development

- [Latent Fingerprint Development Products and Supplies by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development.html): Latent fingerprint development equipment and supplies including reagents and techniques.
- [Regular Latent Fingerprint Powders & Brushes by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/regular-powders-brushes.html): Fingerprint powders and brushes: black, gray, white, and red powder options.
- [Magnetic Latent Fingerprint Powder & Applicators by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/magnetic-powders-applicators.html): Magnetic fingerprint powders and applicators in multiple colors for evidence collection.
- [DNA-Free Latent Fingerprint Processing Products by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/dna-free-latent-print-processing.html): DNA-free fingerprint powders and lifting kits to prevent cross-contamination.
- [Chemical Development of Latent Fingerprints by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/chemical-latent-development.html): Chemical fingerprint development products: cyanoacrylate fuming kits and cartridges.
- [Latent Fingerprint Lifting & Backing by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/latent-print-lifting-backing.html): Fingerprint lifting and preservation: tapes, hinge lifters, gel lifters, and backing supplies.
- [Latent Fingerprint Fuming Chambers by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/fuming-chambers.html): Cyanoacrylate fuming chambers: DeFumigator, CyanoSafe, laboratory and field equipment.
- [Latent Fingerprint Kits by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/latent-print-development/latent-print-kits.html): Complete latent print kits: Patrol, Detective, SEARCH Technician, and evidence recovery.

## RUVIS Imaging & Detection Systems

- [RUVIS Reflected Ultra-Violet Imaging Systems by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/ruvis-systems.html): RUVIS UV imaging systems for no-touch latent fingerprint detection and imaging.
- [RUVIS Reflected Ultra-Violet Imaging Kits by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/ruvis-systems/krimesitetm-imager-kits.html): KRIMESITE IMAGER UV imaging kits with direct view and lens options.
- [RUVIS KrimeSite Capture Systems for the Crime Lab by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/ruvis-systems/krimesite-capture-systems.html): Crime lab RUVIS capture systems for forensic imaging and evidence documentation.
- [Shortwave UV Forensic Light Sources and Accessories by Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/ruvis-systems/shortwave-uv-lights-uv-protection.html): Shortwave UV light sources and safety gear for forensic evidence search and imaging.
- [RUVIS System Accessories from Sirchie](https://www.sirchie.com/forensics/ruvis-systems/ruvis-accessories.html): RUVIS accessories: copy stands, evidence scales, arrow designators, photography tools.
